create_cache_renaming_migration: create a CacheRenamingMigration to rename cache kind field from old to new value
run_cache_migration_up: run the up method on CacheRenamingMigration to update cache kind entries in MongoDB
rollback_cache_migration_down: run the down method on CacheRenamingMigration to rollback cache kind changes
create_queue_renaming_migration: create a QueueRenamingMigration to rename job type and unicity_id fields in MongoDB
validate_migration_documents: run validate on CacheRenamingMigration or QueueRenamingMigration to check modified documents
